coverage: 2000-present: current-Governor proclamation archive from January 2015, plus 41 weather declarations added by hand: 2001-2014 proclamations from archived copies of the Governor's proclamation pages (governor.state.tx.us, via the Wayback Machine) and 2000, 2001, 2002, 2007, 2011, 2015 and 2025 declarations from dated news, National Guard and TDEM coverage. The December 2010 statewide wildfire proclamation, renewed month by month, is counted for DR-1999 through its dated April 15, 2011 renewal and for DR-4029 through the September 6, 2011 release saying it had been reissued nine times and was in force; DR-1730 (Tropical Storm Erin, August 2007) counts as matched only because the Hurricane Dean proclamation of August 17 falls within three weeks of it. No state declaration was found for DR-1356 (December 2000 ice storm), DR-1479 (Claudette, 2003) or DR-1658 (El Paso flooding, 2006)
